newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal ups polyester prices in Europe.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal ups polyester prices in Europe.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said Thursday it is raising the price of its industrial polyster fibers in Europe by 13 percent to reflect higher demand and low levels of supply.
The company said the price hike will take effect July 1.
The increase is essential, following a period of substantial price decline, the company said.
The increase will apply to all polyster fibers produced at AlliedSignal's facilities in Longlaville, France, it said.
The increase will be applied throughout the spectrum of woven, mechanical rubber goods and tire reinforcement products, the company said.
The rise in demand has kept industry manufacturing facilities operating at near full capacity, the company said.
